تحببن (form I)
# تَحْبِبْنَ (taḥbibna) /taħ.bib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# تُحْبَبْنَ (tuḥbabna) /tuħ.bab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# تَحْبُبْنَ (taḥbubna) /taħ.bub.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
